name: coffee-monorepo
description: Monorepo for the grind conversion engine and the apps built on it.

scripts.build: npm run build:data && npm run build -w @coffee/extension
scripts.dev: npm run build:data && npm run dev -w @coffee/extension
scripts.verify: npm run check:data && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
